name: optimizely
summary: Local stand-in for the three SaaS hosts an Optimizely Feature Experimentation SDK (or Optimizely Agent) talks to: datafile CDN, event ingest, and ODP real-time segments.

imposters.surface: CONNECT proxy; forwards cdn/config.optimizely.com -> 4600, logx/eu.logx -> 4601, api.zaius.com -> 4602. LocalStack-style zero-code mode: HTTPS_PROXY + trust GET /intercept/ca.pem

knobs.sdkKey: any value; the path regex accepts every key (fixture declares MOCK_SDK_KEY)
knobs.odpPublicKey: mock-odp-public-key (must equal integrations[odp].publicKey in the datafile)
knobs.lastModified: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT (in imposters.json: one predicate, two headers; bump together with the datafile revision to force pollers to refetch)
knobs.odpHost: env OPTLY_ODP_HOST at rift start: default http://localhost:4602 (direct mode); set https://api.zaius.com for intercept mode

modes.direct: SDK configured with the mock URLs (2 overrides per SDK)
modes.intercept: unmodified SDK, HTTPS_PROXY -> 4610, trust the Rift CA

verify.blackBox: smoke.sh (curl + python3; gated in CI by scripts/verify-templates.sh)
verify.realSdkZeroOverride: sdk_check_localstack.py (optimizely-sdk >= 5.x, Python; intercept mode: HTTPS_PROXY + REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE only)
